title: Perimeter 36, Three Different Sides: How Many Triangles? | AMC 8-Style Level 5
description:
A string 36 units long can bend into lots of triangles, but which ones count? Learn to list them by the longest side so you never miss one or count one twice.
Then see a clever second way: count them all and take away the ones with a repeat.
Try the perimeter-24 challenge at the end!
